findings.disposition_rationale: governance-check integrity leg now passes expectedRunIdForDir(dir); new test over a minted governed anchor (commit 4cbb8f15).
audit verify validates --run-dir, governance material and --run-id before any trust read (commit 4cbb8f15).
trust-file-invalid carries TrustFileError.message as ledger_failures[].detail; trust.source reports the attempted source (commit 4cbb8f15).
Spec trust.present rule corrected and asserted for a failed read (commit d9658df6).
Outcome is absent-or-invalid in every key-failure case; only the reason differs. The spec's Chosen step order (verdict lookup before key failure, with the operator's step-3a exception) mandates it.
atSignedPosition relies on walkPhysicalChain break detection by design; the spec's Assumes about first_break.line was validated against events.js and is pinned by the first_break boundary test.
Spec section 4 requires every Commissaire record to fail commissaire-sig-invalid when no key is trusted; the ledger failure names the cause.
Local transport reads the current repo, but local-ref is never pinned-governor evidence (spec rule); remote is the default transport.
chokepointPermit only permits an effect the signed verdict covers; an unusual kind can only match a verdict the governor signed for that kind.
Whichever candidate file supplies the key, it must match the admission's pk_fingerprint and verify the admission, so a corrupt governor.json cannot change which key is trusted.
Latest-wins by effect kind is the spec's Chosen rule, matching merge-gate today; a deny must be governor-signed, and it can only refuse, never permit.
Deleting the ledger and both key files leaves an ungoverned run; ratified on FAFF-1219 (ungoverned runs stay not-applicable), with FAFF-1028 detecting and FAFF-1220 preventing the bypass.
